note:
HAND-MAINTAINED. Every entry was read off the publishing central bank and carries the source it came from. For two-day meetings the date is the DECISION day, which is the second day.

2026 ONLY, DELIBERATELY. The previous file's 2016-2025 history was reconstructed from memory and about one in eight entries was wrong; there was no way to tell which from inside the file, so all of it was deleted rather than repaired. Chart rules drawn on wrong dates are worse than no rules — a reader would attribute a curve move to a meeting that never happened — so the charts show NO rules before 2026 until verified history exists. That gap is a decision, not an oversight.

Korea's MPC holds 24 regular meetings a year; only the eight 통화정책방향 결정회의 listed here set the policy rate. The 금융안정회의 in March, June, September and December are NOT rate decisions and do not belong in this file.

"verified" is LOAD-BEARING, not documentation: an entry with verified false renders nowhere — not in the strip, not in the countdown, not as a chart rule — and does not count toward the staleness horizon. The file may be used as a staging area, but unverified rows are invisible until someone reads them off the source and flips the flag.

PBOC LPR is not listed here: it is announced on the 20th of each month and is GENERATED by rule in ui/calendar.ts.

guards/calendar.test.ts fails when the last verified entry is under 60 days away. That failure is the reminder to add the next year.
